queries.name: All Object Nodes and Edges
queries.description: Retrieves all nodes and edges in the graph
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Object Nodes
queries.description: Retrieves all nodes in the graph
queries.query:
MATCH (s)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN s
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths From Secrets
queries.description: Retrieves all paths starting from nodes labeled 'Secret
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:Secret)-[]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' and not s.isTlsSecret=true
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths from Pods running as root
queries.description: Retrieves all paths starting from nodes labeled 'Pod' that have the property 'runAsRoot' set to true.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:Pod)-[]->()
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND s.runAsNonRoot = FALSE AND s.runAsUser = 0
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths from Pods running as root, exclude ScheduledOn Edge
queries.description: Retrieves all paths starting from nodes labeled 'Pod' that have the property 'runAsRoot' set to true.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:Pod)-[r]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND s.runAsNonRoot = FALSE AND s.runAsUser = 0 AND NOT type(r) = 'ScheduledOn'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Paths to Nodes with External IPs
queries.description: Retrieves all paths from HTTPRoute nodes to Nodes.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:External)-[*1..3]->(t:K8s_Node)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: All Aggregate Nodes
queries.description: Retrieves all paths from nodes that are aggregates of other nodes.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND t.name STARTS WITH 'ALL'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Paths to AllSecrets
queries.description: Retrieves all paths to the AllSecrets aggregate node.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t:AllSecrets)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Paths to AllPods
queries.description: Retrieves all paths to the AllPods aggregate node.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s)-[]->(t:AllPods)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND t.name STARTS WITH 'ALL'
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Pods Sharing Process Namespace
queries.description: Retrieves all pods with shareProcessNamespace enabled.
queries.query:
MATCH (p:Pod)
WHERE p.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}' AND p.shareProcessNamespace = TRUE
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Full External Attack Paths
queries.description: All paths reachable from the External node up to 6 hops deep.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:External)-[*1..6]->(t)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 500

queries.name: External to Pod via Service
queries.description: Paths where an externally-exposed Service routes to a pod.
queries.query:
MATCH p=(s:External)-[:ExternalRoutesTo]->(svc)-[:RoutesTo]->(pod:Pod)
WHERE s.cluster = '{{.Cluster}}'
RETURN p
LIMIT 500
